Removing Cache Components code needs no entry here: that side is driven
entirely by the @cache-components-only markers in the source.
Both implementations invalidate with updateTag, so rewriteCalls is a
no-op kept only because applyInvalidations reads it unconditionally —
the real work here is companionTags below. The list tags have no Cache
Components counterpart: a `use cache` boundary can tag itself with
per-record ids after its fetch resolves, but a fetch tag has to be known
before the request is issued, so listings carry only the shared tag and
every mutation has to invalidate it explicitly.
